findings.title: False protection turns servanthood into rival authority
findings.claim: The questioned supposition treats God's servants as independent protectors, so a relation of belonging is recast as an alternate source of protection.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier حَسِبَ carries a non-certain judgment; the independent focus relation عِبَادِي ... مِنْ دُونِي أَوْلِيَاءَ and the exact same-surah parallel at 18:50 expose the attempted reassignment of servants into rival guardians. The wider 104:3 surface supplies a bounded parallel in which supposition builds false security around a possession.
findings.reader_payoff: The question becomes an exposure of false security: the imagined protectors are already named as servants, while the act of making them independent guardians changes their assigned role.
findings.containment: The plain question and its warning remain intact. The 18:50 and 104:3 connections are used for their supplied relation and target surface only; no target-side morphology or wider theological system is inferred.

epistemic.reason: The core semantic relation is stated in trusted cross-run support and is independently returned through the exact focus carrier, focus relation, and supplied same-surah target Arabic; connection-level qualifications limit only the wider parallel.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi, kesinlik bulunmadığı halde bir durumun öyle olduğuna zihnen yönelir.
branch_activations.carrier: حَسِبَ carries a non-certain mental judgment in the focus.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus places God's servants beside alternative protectors, while 18:50 repeats the same ally-taking relation and 104:3 supplies a parallel of supposition making false security.
branch_activations.activation: The lexical supposition meets a concrete alternative-protection relation, so the question reads as exposure of a chosen but unsupported security arrangement.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The imagined protection is a role error: a dependent servant is treated as an independent guardian and the supposition becomes self-protective rather than merely uncertain.
branch_activations.boundary: This retains the focus's question and does not claim that every wider use of حَسِبَ has this sense or that the target connections provide missing morphology.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: Tanrı'ya ait sayılan insan veya topluluk
branch_activations.facet_statement: Her insan yaratılmışlık ve aitlik bakımından Tanrı'nın kulu sayılabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: عِبَادِي carries the focus's belonging relation for God's servants.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: أَوْلِيَاءَ مِنْ دُونِي and the same-surah 18:50 wording place an alternative guardian role against that belonging.
branch_activations.activation: The servant designation and the rival-guardian relation make contact as opposed assignments of status.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The warning becomes legible as an attempted transfer of agency and allegiance from the owner to those already described as belonging to Him.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation concerns the supplied belonging-versus-protector relation; it does not generalize the branch to every use of عَبْد.

findings.title: Prepared hospitality becomes the disbeliever's lodging
findings.claim: The noun نُزُلًا lets Hell appear as a prepared reception: the hospitality category remains visible while the false allegiance receives an opposite outcome, a lodging that exposes the refuge it expected.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier نُزُلًا names the guest's prepared provision, while أَعْتَدْنَا, جَهَنَّمَ, and the supplied wider occurrences at 18:29, 18:53, 3:198, 32:19, 56:93, 56:56, and the retrospective 18:107 report provide independent reception and outcome triggers. Their contact changes Hell from a bare destination into a deliberately readied reception whose host-guest relation has been reversed.
findings.reader_payoff: The word for welcome remains audible inside the warning: what looks like refuge from false protectors is prepared as the reception awaiting those who chose them, while the same hospitality category can also name a contrary prepared reception for believers.
findings.containment: The plain claim that Hell was prepared for disbelievers remains primary. The 18:107 paired contrast is retained as qualified retrospective evidence, not as proof of an authorial design beyond the supplied packet; target morphology for connection rows is not supplied.

epistemic.reason: The core hospitality reversal is grounded by trusted cross-run support and exact focus carrier; the paired 18:107 detail is legacy_unbound, and connection targets are surface-level evidence with explicit morphology limits.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: konuk için hazırlanan yiyecek ve ağırlama payı
branch_activations.facet_statement: Konuğun yararlanması için yiyecek, yol azığı ve ağırlama payı hazırlanır.
branch_activations.carrier: نُزُلًا carries the prepared provision and hospitality share offered to a guest.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: أَعْتَدْنَا and جَهَنَّمَ in the focus, together with the supplied prepared-lodging and paired-reception targets, turn the hospitality carrier toward a punitive reception.
branch_activations.activation: The guest-provision sense meets an explicitly prepared Hell and wider exact surfaces where nuzul names opposed receptions, preserving hospitality while reversing its expected welcome.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Hell is heard as the prepared reception for the false allegiance, not only as a final place named after the judgment.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not make nuzul a synonym for Hell, and the wider target rows are not given un supplied morphology or an adjudicated cross-ayah thesis.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: gelecekteki bir iş için hazırlama ve hazır bulundurma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi gelecekteki belirli bir iş veya olay için önceden hazırlamak.
branch_activations.carrier: أَعْتَدْنَا presents the act of preparing something in advance for a later event.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: نُزُلًا supplies the concrete reception for which the preparation is made, and 18:29 repeats the prepared-fire/result relation within the same surah.
branch_activations.activation: The preparation verb meets the hospitality noun as a planned allocation, making the destination read as an already readied reception.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The outcome has been set aside and made ready for the later arrival of its guests.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a bounded preparedness resonance; it does not claim a timetable, inventory, or every dictionary branch of the preparation root.

findings.title: Servanthood keeps the messenger within the warning
findings.claim: The focus's servant-and-alternative-protector relation also sets a boundary for a human messenger: the supplied 18:110 retrospective keeps a servant within exclusive divine oneness rather than turning him into an independent object of allegiance.
findings.mechanism: The legacy reader-walk support names 18:110's pairing of messenger humanity with exclusive divine oneness and returns that wider trigger through the focus phrase عِبَادِي ... مِنْ دُونِي أَوْلِيَاءَ. The contact changes the focus from a warning about unnamed substitutes into a role boundary that includes the status of a human intermediary.
findings.reader_payoff: The warning reaches its own messenger boundary: a servant can transmit or point toward the divine relation while remaining inside it, not becoming the rival protection the question exposes.
findings.containment: This is an attributed, qualified contextual resonance because the packet supplies the 18:110 report but not its exact target Arabic or morphology. It does not replace the plain question or generalize beyond the supplied servant/protector relation.

epistemic.reason: The wider trigger and focus return are stated in a supplied legacy reader-walk support, but exact target-side surface evidence is not included.
